Help centre

How can we help?

Quick guidance for the Gabber beta. An official support email will be added here before public release.

Support setup pending: Do not publish this page publicly until a monitored support email is available.

I cannot receive an OTP

Confirm the country code and phone number, check your connection, wait briefly, and request a new code. Never share an OTP with another person.

Notifications are not arriving

Open your phone's app settings, allow notifications for Gabber and confirm battery-saving settings are not preventing background activity.

A voice or video call disconnected

Check that Gabber has microphone and camera permission and that both callers have a stable connection. Reopen the active call banner if the call was minimised.

I found unsafe content or an account

Use the block and report controls available from the relevant chat or profile. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

I need to change or remove business information

Use the Business Dashboard in Gabber. Verification decisions and submitted documents may require manual support review.

I want to delete my account

Read the current instructions on the account deletion page.
